basis: Johnson Daoist Exorcism, owner-supplied PDF, printed pp.121-128 and 238-241
ritual: altar purification opening excerpt with one-through-ten prelude
safety: virtual_text_only; no physical effect, initiation or power claim

cues.name: one
cues.movement_and_visualization: Wuji with feet slightly wider than shoulders; five linked attentional passes: front (thumb+index down, weight balls of feet), back (ring+little fingers down, heels), head/arms (balance centered), chest/abdomen (middle fingers down), legs/feet; source describes three tongue stations, final wood/upper-palate retained

cues.name: two
cues.movement_and_visualization: Extended Fan Palm from hips rotating toward front/sides/back; visualize outward Earth contact in five directions

cues.name: three
cues.movement_and_visualization: Sword Fingers hand seal; imagined roots twice body height extending forward/back/left/right/down

cues.name: four
cues.movement_and_visualization: Open palms and Bellows Palm movement of hips/chest/arms; imagined golden streams rising to Lower Dantian, up back, over head, down front

cues.name: five
cues.movement_and_visualization: Palms face outward; imagined two golden streams out along both arms to the room with hip/chest/arm movements

cues.name: six
cues.movement_and_visualization: Palms turn inward; imagine filling the room from six directions and expansion/contraction with natural breathing

cues.name: seven
cues.movement_and_visualization: Mighty Light Hand Seal; palms toward body, fingers angled in, wrists pressed outward gently, chin slightly tucked; pole star above, feet rooted to Earth

cues.name: eight
cues.movement_and_visualization: From Mighty Light release ring fingers -> Celestial Fire; thumb covers tip of middle-finger nail; rotate inward on comfortable inhale and outward on comfortable exhale

cues.name: nine
cues.movement_and_visualization: Release middle fingers -> Extended Fan Palm; palms inward on inhale and outward on exhale; imagined white light fills room and ten directions

cues.name: ten
cues.movement_and_visualization: Begin: transition to Three Invocations or Shi Shou, not a standalone magical formula nor complete rite ending

cues.name: incense-bow
cues.movement_and_visualization: three sticks / Yintang / three bows, virtual

cues.name: turn-west
cues.movement_and_visualization: three westward steps with Wind/Thunder/Celestial Fire cue

cues.name: chi-sign
cues.movement_and_visualization: sword fingers / Chi / clockwise virtual energy

cues.name: return-east
cues.movement_and_visualization: three invocations and white pearl at lower Dantian

cues.name: circles
cues.movement_and_visualization: three dimensional Jing / Qi / Shen circles from east

cues.name: close-adapted
cues.movement_and_visualization: return to Wuji, explicitly NOT source's full rite ending

local_rehearsal.mode: deterministic textual replay; not embodied learning

source_audit.correction: One is Fun contains five microstages; directions E in earlier 1-10 were overinferred; hand-seal transitions Seven->Eight->Nine need explicit finger movements
